title: Glass mark macro orbit, light-on and dive
summary: Macro glimpses of a blue glass mark, then a thin glowing slab drifting through black; it turns face-on, goes dark, lights up with a wide halo, the camera dives through it into a glowing wordmark and a tagline.
use_when: A logo teaser or brand intro where the mark itself is the story
A dark, cinematic opener before a launch film
A brand with a simple geometric mark that reads as an extruded solid
A silent autoplay piece that needs suspense before the name

look.type_style: medium geometric sans, sentence case, normal tracking, about 4 % of frame height, centred, soft white glow

sfx.event: specular patch sweeps across a facet in the macro shots
face-on mark lights up, halo blooms

structure.shot: macro of a translucent blue glass solid, blown cyan specular patches on its facets, frame brightens to full blue
structure.camera: orbit-3d slide along the edge: drift down-left then pushes in, about +15 %/s to +40 %/s from 2.00 s
structure.motion: specular patches travel across facets about 250-300 px/s at 1920 W, easings.linear; no object spring

structure.shot: second macro angle: the curved top of the glass mark from below, highlight moves from the inner corner to the right edge
structure.camera: orbit-3d slow push-in about +12 to +21 %/s with a slight roll
structure.motion: highlight band slides along the facet, easings.inOutSine over about 60 fr (±0.25 s); body barely moves

structure.shot: the mark edge-on as a thin bright slab on black, sliding left to right across the frame with a wide blue halo behind
structure.camera: lateral travel left to right about 330-410 px/s at 1920 W, easings.linear; slab rises from 0.17 H to 0.6 H
structure.motion: slab segments catch light in turn; one-frame pink/green fringe at 9.50; halo pulses with the bright segments

structure.shot: closer edge-on pass: slab larger and soft-focused, parts come in and out of focus, frame lifts to mid blue
structure.camera: push-in about +76 %/s at 12.50 then lateral drift right about 300 px/s
structure.motion: defocus shifts between near and far ends of the slab over about 15 fr (±0.25 s); easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: edge-on slab seen nearly end-on, sliding out to the right edge, background dims back to black
structure.camera: lateral travel right about 600-800 px/s at 1920 W, easings.linear
structure.motion: 3 fr dissolve in; slab exits frame right by 17.50

structure.shot: the mark far away as a tiny glowing sliver, about 0.05 W wide, drifting near centre on black
structure.camera: static far wide, sliver drifts about 1 % of W per second
structure.motion: glint travels along the sliver every about 0.75 s (±0.25 s); faint halo field

structure.shot: the sliver rotates from edge-on to face-on, the mark shape appears and goes almost black mid-turn, then picks up dim blue
structure.camera: static; object rotates about 90 deg on X over about 75 fr, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)
structure.motion: brightness falls to about #0A1A40 at 22.77, returns to dim blue #113DBB by 23.77

structure.shot: face-on mark lights up from dim blue to cyan core, halo blooms behind it
structure.camera: static, centred, mark height about 0.15 H
structure.motion: light-on S-curve: core lights over 14 fr, halo lags 5 fr and keeps building for about 30 fr

structure.shot: lit mark holds centred on a two-radius blue halo field
structure.camera: push-in about +0.75 %/frame on the last 27 fr (mark 67 to 81 px wide at 720 p)
structure.motion: halo grows to the frame edge; no overshoot

structure.shot: camera dives at the mark, mark grows from 0.09 W to over 0.34 W with a slight tilt
structure.camera: zoom-through, easings.inExpo on ln(scale): per-frame growth 1.01 to 1.18 over 29 fr
structure.motion: mark body shifts from cyan to blue as it nears; halo brightens

structure.shot: the mark rim fills the frame, then black
structure.motion: 1 fr glow, then about 5 fr of pure black

structure.shot: the product name, one word, centred on black in grey, flares blue and settles white with a soft glow
structure.motion: fade in grey over about 8 fr (±0.25 s); flare up about 9 fr at 30.10, back about 9 fr; easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: name gets a period, a 4-word tagline wipes on to its right, the whole line re-centres; a blue light window travels along the words
structure.motion: line wipes left to right over about 15 fr (±0.25 s); re-centre springs.layout about 15 fr (±0.25 s); light window sweeps the tagline over about 20 fr

structure.shot: the full line breaks into an RGB-split and slice glitch, then snaps clean
structure.motion: glitch on 2 bursts at 33.00 and 33.50, each about 4 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: name and tagline hold in white with a soft glow on black

structure.motion: fade out easings.linear about 15 fr (±0.25 s)

params.mark: brand mark as a simple geometric vector; reads best as one extruded solid
params.content.name: product name, one word, shown after the dive
params.content.tagline: short tagline, about 4 words, wipes on after the name
params.timing.compress: scale of the macro and slab rows; a launch-film cut keeps 23.77-31.5 and shortens the rest
params.palette: one brand blue for body and halo, cyan only in the lit core

notes: Measured by hand at 30 fps: light-on core 14 fr S-curve from #113DBB to #62FBFF, halo lags 5 fr and grows another ~30 fr; halo has two radii (tight about 1x mark, field 4-5x mark), pure blue, only the core goes cyan. Push-in on the hold +0.75 %/frame. Zoom-through: width 111 to 432 px over 29 fr, per-frame growth 1.01 to 1.18 (accelerating on ln scale), then 1 fr glow, 5 fr black. Text flare up ~9 fr, down ~9 fr. No overshoot anywhere: heavy damping. Specular sweeps 250-300 px/s at 1080p. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): specular-sweep, type-wipe-on, light-window-sweep. Cuts at 12.27 and 17.77 are near-miss jumps read from the sheets. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
